thread:
alex_chan: quick heads-up — legal oncall pinged me about BYOK pilot. They want a phasegate for keystore acceptance + an explicit oncall escalation path. Can we decide today?

maria_g: ok. what exactly are they asking for? scope? SLA? :eyes:

alex_chan: scope: 1) keystore handshake success metrics 2) retention proof artifacts 3) rollback triggers for vault rotation. They want canary before tenant-wide cutover.

devin_s: ops perspective: can do a canary with 5 tenants, monitor error rate and audit log mismatch. Need a runbook snippet though.

sarah_k: security: add proof-of-possession check during handshake and require HSM attestation for gov customers. also require kms key id pinned in audit logs.

anil_p: legal: oncall wants 24/7 escalation for any evidence export or failed handshake that could cause customer data exposure. We need contact matrix + SLA windows.

alex_chan: proposed phasegate (short): PRE-ROLL: integration tests + attestation ok; CANARY: 5 tenants 48h monitoring; FULL: 7-day health window post-cutover. Rollback if error rate > 0.5% OR audit export errors > 1/day. Thoughts?

maria_g: fine, but 0.5% seems tight for first rollout. Suggest 1% for initial canary then tighten. Also need UX flag so customers can opt-out during canary.

devin_s: agree with opt-out flag. Operational metrics we'll watch: handshake_failure_count, audit_export_failures, latency_p95. I'll wire dashboards and alert thresholds.

sarah_k: add requirement: immutable audit log entries for handshake events, with proof-of-auth header. Also retention policy for handshake evidence = 90 days for pilot.

anil_p: escalation chain: page legal_oncall -> legal_oncall oncall person -> product lead. Need contact details + response SLA (30m ack, 4h resolution or mitigation).

alex_chan: ok I'll draft contact matrix. @devin_s can you paste the runbook snippet you mentioned?

devin_s: sure — here's a minimal canary rollback step:

```
- Trigger: handshake_failure_rate > 1% over 30m OR audit_export_failures >= 2 in 1h
- Action: rollback to previous keystore handshake flow (toggle `keystore.v1`)
- Notify: #incidents, legal_oncall, product_oncall, infra-oncall
- Postmortem owner: product
```

maria_g: looks good. We also need acceptance artifact: small signed evidence package that legal can pull for compliance. Can we auto-generate?

sarah_k: yes. ops can sign with KMS and store digest in audit-archives. I'll coordinate with devin.

anil_p: legal also wants a template for evidence requests and time-to-deliver (48h). We'll add to runbook.

alex_chan: next steps: 1) devin wires dashboards + runbook 2) sarah & devin define attestation checks 3) maria drafts opt-out UX + acceptance artifact 4) anil finalizes escalation SLAs. Week target: finish by EOD Friday.

devin_s: starting now. will ping when dashboards wired. :rocket:

maria_g: adding ticket to roadmap board. @alex_chan can you cc legal in the ticket?

alex_chan: done — added anil. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

legal_oncall_bot: FYI — uploaded template: /playbooks/byok-keystore-phasegate (runbook v1). Page legal_oncall on incidents if anything breaks.
